services.name: Strategy & creative
services.text: We research your world with a SITREP, find the angle and write the script.
services.more: Before anyone picks up a camera, we work out what the film has to do and who it has to reach. Our SITREP research into your craft, your peers and your industry points us to the story worth telling, and then we write it.
services.includes: SITREP research, positioning, concepts, scripts, distribution plans

services.name: Pre-production
services.text: We handle the producing, casting, locations, storyboards and schedule.
services.more: This is the unglamorous work that makes shoot day look easy. We find the right people and the right places, then write a plan everyone on set can follow.
services.includes: Producing, casting, locations, permits, storyboards, schedules

services.name: Production
services.text: We direct, shoot, light and record sound, on the ground and in the air.
services.more: We bring cinema cameras, lighting, sound and aerials, run by a crew with a decade in the field. We'll shoot on location, in the studio or wherever the story happens to be.
services.includes: Directing, cinematography, lighting, sound, drone, cable cam and high-speed rigs

services.name: Post-production
services.text: We edit, color, design the sound and cut a version for every screen.
services.more: This is where the story comes together. We edit, color, mix and animate, then cut a version for every place the film needs to play.
services.includes: Editing, color grading, motion graphics, subtitles, social cutdowns

services.name: Commercial photography
services.text: We shoot stills with the same eye: brand imagery, portraits, products and behind the scenes.
services.more: Our stills come from the same eye as our films. We can shoot them alongside the video or on their own.
services.includes: Brand imagery, portraits, products, behind the scenes

services.name: Audio & sound design
services.text: We score, record, design and mix sound, and we produce podcasts too.
services.more: Sound is half the picture. We score, design and mix it so it holds up on a phone speaker or in a theater.
services.includes: Original score, sound design, voiceover, mixing, podcasts

services.name: Rentals
services.text: You can rent our cinema cameras, lenses, lighting and audio, with or without our crew.
services.more: Our own cinema kit is available to rent, with our crew or without it.
services.includes: Cameras, lenses, lighting, audio, crew optional

industries.name: Medical & Biotech

industries.title: Care and accuracy, on camera.
industries.intro: Medicine is hard to film well. The science has to be right, patients have to feel safe, and the film still has to hold someone's attention. We've done it for Boston Scientific, Thermo Fisher and Nektar, and for clinics and practices across Phoenix.

faq.q: Can you film in a hospital or clinic?
faq.a: Yes. We work around patients and staff, follow your facility's rules and bring only the crew the shot needs. Tell us the restrictions early and we'll plan the shoot around them.

faq.q: Do you make videos for medical device and biotech companies?
faq.a: We do. We've made product films and patient stories for companies like Boston Scientific and Nektar, with shorter cuts for sales teams, conferences and social.

industries.about: Medicine is hard to film well, because the science has to be right and patients have to feel safe. Here's Mike's story, which we made with Nektar:
industries.heading: The science has to be right.
industries.approach: We check every claim with your team before anything ships, and we build the review rounds into the schedule instead of squeezing them in at the end. On set we keep things quiet, explain everything up front and never push for a moment someone isn't ready to share. Then we turn procedures and mechanisms into clear pictures and plain words, so a patient, a buyer or a board member gets it the first time. Here are a few of the films we've made in medicine:

industries.name: Tribal Nations

industries.title: In their own voices.
industries.intro: We make public health, education and civic films with the Inter Tribal Council of Arizona, which represents 21 tribal nations. The lesson has been the same every time: do the research first, then let community members tell their own stories.

faq.q: Have you worked with tribal governments before?
faq.a: Yes. Our work for the Inter Tribal Council of Arizona includes WIC nutrition PSAs, vaccine education for its Tribal Epidemiology Center and Your Voice, Your Power, a 10-part docuseries on tribal voting.

faq.q: What does a SITREP add to a film for tribal communities?
faq.a: It finds the real barrier before we film. For ITCA's WIC program, our research showed the problem was trust, not awareness, and that changed the whole direction of the films.

That way the film speaks to it instead of around it. Leaders, elders, mothers and young voters speak for themselves, with no outside narrator. We film where people live and work, and we ask before we point a camera at anything. Here's some of the work we've made together:

cases.title: Dear Mom
cases.text: Tribal mothers speak straight to other mothers, so families trust WIC enough to enroll.
cases.story: The Inter Tribal Council of Arizona's WIC program had eligible families who weren't enrolling. Our SITREP research found the barrier was trust, not awareness. So we put tribal mothers on camera talking straight to other mothers, with no narration and no institutional voice, and we shot them in unbroken takes so they read as neighbors.

cases.lede: Tribal mothers speak straight to other mothers, so families trust WIC enough to enroll.
sitrep: When ITCA came to us, its WIC program needed more families enrolled. Participation had been falling even though plenty of families were eligible.
Our research found that many tribal members linked WIC with government surveillance. The barrier wasn't awareness, it was trust.
So we filmed tribal mothers speaking straight to camera in unbroken takes, with no narration and no institutional framing.

process.name: Idea
process.text: Bring us an idea, a brief or a blank page, and we'll find the story in it together.
process.more: It starts with a call. Bring us a spark, a brief or a blank page, and we'll talk it through until we know what's worth saying.

process.name: Discovery
process.text: We listen first: to your people, your history and what you hope the film will do.
process.more: We listen first: to your people, your history, the people you want to reach and what you hope to leave behind. You come away with a clear plan, a schedule and a budget.

process.name: SITREP
process.text: We research your craft, your peers and your industry, then bring you a point of view on the story.
process.more: SITREP is our research. Before we film, we dig into your craft, your peers, your industry and the wider sector, like an outside R&D department that cares about your story as much as you do. Then we bring you a point of view and help steer the film toward the story worth telling.

process.name: Production
process.text: Our crew shoots it with cinema cameras and real care, on location or in the studio.
process.more: Our crew shoots with cinema cameras, lighting and sound, on location or in the studio, and one of our founders leads every shoot.

process.name: Completion
process.text: We edit, color, mix and deliver it, and we make it to hold up for years.
process.more: We edit, color and mix the film, then cut a version for every place it needs to play. We make it to hold up for years, not just for launch week.
